            (ψ (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.horizontal y)) →
          φ (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.affine x y) =
            Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.affine (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.coordX ψ x)
              (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.coordY ψ y)

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  (φ : Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Point K 2 → Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Point L 2)
  (ψ : Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Hyperplane K 2 → Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Hyperplane L 2),
  Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.Protected φ ψ →
    ∀ (b : Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Point K 2 → Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Hyperplane K 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ (p : Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Point K 2) (H : Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Hyperplane K 2), 0 ≤ b p H) →
        (∀ (p : Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Point K 2) (H : Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Hyperplane K 2),
            Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Incident p H → ¬Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Incident (φ p) (ψ H) → 1 ≤ b p H) →
          Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.cost b ≤ 1 / 10000000 →
            (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.count fun x => ¬Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.ProperX ψ x) ≤
                17 * Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.cost b * ↑(Fintype.card K) ∧
              (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.count fun y => ¬Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.ProperY ψ y) ≤
                  17 * Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.cost b * ↑(Fintype.card K) ∧
                ∃ σ,
                  (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.count fun x => Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.coordX ψ x ≠ σ x) ≤
                      288 * Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.cost b * ↑(Fintype.card K) ∧
                    (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.count fun y => Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.coordY ψ y ≠ σ y) ≤
                        648 * Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.cost b * ↑(Fintype.card K) ∧
                      (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.count fun z =>
                          φ (Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.affine z.1 z.2) ≠
                            Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.affine (σ z.1) (σ z.2)) ≤
                        971 * Erdos85.IncidenceRepair.Plane.cost b * ↑(Fintype.card K) ^ 2
